items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 4 May 2026 4:12pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 04 May 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic, building a ridge across the Irish Sea, weak area of low pressure and associated frontal zone affecting the north of Scotland.


##Wind##

North or northwest 2 to 4, but variable 3 or less in the west of the area at first, increasing force 5 in places tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair, isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest, soon veering east or northeast, 4 or 5, veering south or southeast 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the west later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
